scope: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Complete ledger copied directly from clean21; no compilation/test/DB run; production file unchanged; parent combines Search transport diagnostic overlay before build.
logging_contract: All memory/unknown rejection counter sites are instrumented once under the existing mutex. Policy, counters, timeouts, wake logic, lease ownership and thresholds are unchanged.

Non-counted invalid SetWorking/ReserveResult and wire-state hard errors are also logged; invalid negative-input branches briefly acquire only the same ledger mutex for a consistent diagnostic snapshot.
ReserveWire admission aliases are already recorded by admit/unknown and are not double-logged as a second independent rejection.
SetWorking old_working/new_working and need are exact locked values; new_working represents requested at other stages and is interpreted by stage.
Global native/typed preparing Working, total result/window/extra, actual wire bytes/count and resident ownership are recorded to distinguish initial conservative reservations from retained pressure.
Callers are bounded to 12 program counters, symbolized only as function@basename:line; no stack arguments, request IDs, resource paths, payloads or credentials are read/logged.
Only hard rejection paths log; converging waits and successful reserve/shrink paths do not log.
Any binary built with this overlay is diagnostic-only even if embedded VCS metadata still reports clean.
